## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head c77091a6 · 2026-11-24T11:35Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `c77091a618590d63b15ba6fe0576c1ee01c8b5c8`
Reviewer: L1-b (seat 3, area ux-E). Contract review: none owed. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed rule text.
Tier H, by size: +6516/−6316 = 12,832 changed lines, over the 3,000-line line. This is card #36893's only PR. This verdict goes to the seat, which hands the PR to the maintainer. The draft stays a draft.

### Read
- Net diff `origin/main...c77091a6` (base `62692b7f`), the PR body with its verbatim script and output, card #36893, and dev report 7130229692.
- Check-runs on `c77091a6`: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Both blockers are closed: #36502 merged as #36884, and #36505 is closed as completed.

### Move-only, checked independently
I did not rely on the PR's own script. I compared, as line multisets, the lines removed from `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` with the full text of the three new files.
- **New-file lines not removed from SDS: 206.** Every one is an import line, an import-list member, the copyright line, a blank line, or the three new module headers. That leaves 0 code lines that did not come out of SDS.
- **Lines removed from SDS but not in the new files: 37.** All are import members or import lines that SDS no longer needs, plus the `#29988` re-export comment and line, which moved below the new imports.
- **Lines added to SDS: 15.** Four import lines for the pillars and `renderStudioGridList`, five narrowed import lines, and three re-export comments with their `export { … }`.
- There is no copied helper, because duplication would show as extra new-file lines. There is no circular import: none of the three files imports `StudioDesignSurface`.
- SDS goes from 8,010 to 1,715 lines, under the card's "about 5,600".

### Checklist
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36893`. The PR delivers the whole card.
- **Scope.** The three new pillar modules, SDS, and the three by-path readers.
  - 7373: `alsoReads` gains the three files.
  - 7265: `SITES` gains the three files.
  - 13461: the census re-points its six rows to the module each one now lives in. The count is the same, six before and six after, so nothing is dropped.
- **Changeset.** `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, internal move-only, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The package's public exports are unchanged, because SDS re-exports all four names.
- **Card acceptance.**
  - Full UI tests and type check pass: met. Test UI, TypeScript Type Check, and Lint & Repo Gates are green on the head.
  - The SDS diff is only removals and re-exports, with import narrowing as needed: met.
  - The moved function bodies match the original line for line, and the PR carries the comparison method: met. The PR's script and sha256 values are in the body, and my own multiset check agrees.
  - SDS is under about 5,600 lines: met, at 1,715.

### Findings
No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N1 (nit), declared.** There is a new `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning on SDS's re-export of `renderStudioGridList`. It only affects HMR granularity during development. It can go away when the re-export's callers import from `DataPillar.tsx` directly.
- **N2 (nit).** `l1-face` flags `@object-ui/components` as touched with no changeset. The one file is `src/__tests__/clickableNonControlCensus-13461.test.ts`, a test that does not ship, so no changeset entry is owed.

### Note to the seat
- This is Tier H on size alone. Hand it to the maintainer as it is: one PR for the whole card, with the move-only evidence above and in the PR body.
- After it merges, SDS is 1,715 lines. Any open ux-E or ux-E2 branch that edits a pillar inside SDS must re-base its hunks onto the new modules.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c77091a618590d63b15ba6fe0576c1ee01c8b5c8`
Local-runs: probe — move-only multiset check
Scope: none + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AccessPillar.tsx
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #36956, card #36893. Size-only Tier H (6,516 + 6,316 = 12,832 changed lines, 8 files), no `reviewFace` hit; the review is scoped to move-only verification, as the seat asked. Read: the net diff `62692b7f..c77091a6`, the PR body, card #36893 with all four comments (claim 7127355037, blocked report 7127606539, amendment 7128762472, dev report 7130229692), the two PR comments, and the 58 check-runs on the head (45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending). The probe was a read-only script over `git show` output of the four files at base and head; nothing was built, tested or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Moved text is verbatim — right.** The four base ranges of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (SDS) appear contiguously, in order and unaltered in the new files: `AccessPillar.tsx` 1947-1971 (25 lines) and 6980-8008 (1,029), `DataPillar.tsx` 1973-4899 (2,927), `AutomationsPillar.tsx` 4904-6978 (2,075). My sha256 of each block matches the PR body's 16-hex prefixes (`6992ca733d12063a`, `aa6b436a3bcacc05`, `310655239c9c9faf`, `b917d07fef64e35a`).
- **Nothing else is in the new files — right.** Outside the moved blocks each file holds only the copyright line, one header comment, its import block and blank lines (Data 200 lines, Automations 160, Access 59). No helper is rewritten or duplicated: none of `StudioNameLabel`, `ObjDraftSend`, `readPublishedFlowNames`, `NewSimilarStrip`, `NEW_SIMILAR_ARRIVAL_STATE`, `readNewSimilarArrival` remains in SDS at head.
- **SDS remainder is unchanged — right.** Base SDS minus the four ranges, diffed against head SDS, differs only in the import block (specifiers and whole import lines dropped, five lines narrowed, three pillar imports added), two blank lines, and two added re-export statements with their comments. No statement outside imports and re-exports changed. The `#29988` re-export pair shows as added in the raw diff only because the text around it was deleted.
- **No published export is lost — right.** SDS's `export` set at base and head differs only in form: `AccessPillar`, `AutomationsPillar`, `DataPillar` and `renderStudioGridList` go from declarations to `export { … }` re-exports of the same bindings. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` is not in the diff and names only `StudioDesignSurface` from this file; the package `exports` map has `.` and `./styles.css` alone, so no deep path was ever published. The new modules export exactly those four names and nothing new.
- **No cycle, no split state — right.** None of the three modules imports SDS or each other. The only non-test importers of SDS are `index.ts`, `StudioMetadataArea.tsx` and `StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`, and no pillar imports any of them, so no new path leads back to SDS. The moved text has no module-level `let`/`var`, collection or context; its only top-level value is the string constant `NEW_SIMILAR_ARRIVAL_STATE`, private to `AccessPillar.tsx`.
- **By-path readers re-pointed, not weakened — right.** 7373: `alsoReads` +3 paths, 0 removed; the site still reads SDS first. 7265: `SITES` +3 paths, 0 removed. 13461: 42 rows at base and 42 at head; six rows re-keyed (5 `NOT_CONTROLS`, 1 `BACKLOG`) with the same keys and reasons (2 `clearFieldSelOnEmpty` CANVAS, 3 `setRailOpen` SCRIM, 1 backlog key), now on the file each site lives in. The two other tests that name SDS (`noRetiredSetupLink-28578`, `noSetupMetadataLink-28578`) walk the directory, so they read the new files without an edit. `Test UI` (16/16 shards) is green on the head.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/36893-sds-pillar-split.md` reads `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines. That is right: the package's public surface and runtime behaviour are unchanged, and no spec schema, metadata type or protocol file is in the diff. `@object-ui/components` is touched by one test file only, which does not ship, so it owes no entry. `Check Changeset` is green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 7130229692 has `open_questions: []`. The one earlier question (7127606539, the one-line conflict with PR #36888) is closed by the merge of `origin/main`: `withoutReplacedPlacements` is kept in SDS and `type CustomizeBlock` left with its only reader, `AutomationsPillar.tsx`. Confirmed in the head tree.
- Declared deviation: one new `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning on SDS's re-export of `renderStudioGridList`. It is a warning, `Lint UI` is green, and a suppression line in SDS would be a non-move line. Accepted.
- Out-of-scope prose that still cites SDS for moved text (three checklist area files, `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`, a line citation in `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`): read by no gate, outside this card's surface, carried by the seat.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. No query, id materialisation or join is added; the diff moves UI code.

### ④ Design judgment

No `hits` file. For the four implementing files, the contract is the card's: move only, SDS keeps re-exports, by-path readers updated in the same PR (ruling 6597555122 item 3), SDS under about 5,600 lines. Each holds against the tree, per ①; SDS is 1,715 lines. I tried to break it three ways — a moved block edited in place, a helper left behind or copied, and a name dropped from SDS's exports — and found none.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — the declared `react-refresh` warning on SDS's `renderStudioGridList` re-export; development HMR granularity only. Leave as an accepted deviation.
- N2 (nit) — the `Security-touching` reading: `AccessPillar.tsx` is permission UI, but its text is moved unchanged, so no hunk teaches or alters security behaviour.

## 维护者速读

- Studio 专题 #36890 主线上的拆文件卡：把 `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里的「数据、自动化、权限」三个分区原样搬到各自的文件，界面和行为都不变。这个文件从 8,010 行降到 1,715 行，之后的专题卡可以同时开工，不再挤同一个文件。
- 一张卡一个 PR（没有拆分）。共 12,832 行，几乎全是搬动（+6,516 / −6,316），所以需要您批准。
- 怎么快速确认是纯搬移：PR 正文里有逐段的 sha256 比对；评审也独立核对了搬动前后文本一致、导出的名字不变、没有新增循环引用。
- 检查全绿。批准后由维护者入队；合并后，还在改这几个分区的分支要把改动挪到新文件。
